wider_search.limits: Owners come from prior native-table physical-prefix slots whose full header parser passed, including overlapping tails. This is a candidate-owner search, not a certified world map. Each root is bounded to 256 instructions/1024 states/depth 8; all frontiers counted. Text start search uses incoming ROM pointers within 2500 bytes. Raw hits and unsupported contexts are retained; computed IDs, unindexed data and indirect/native execution can escape this search.

conclusion: Strong evidence of an unfinished local puzzle/battle in the default room: introduction removes Mister R, accessible behavior dispatch is flavor text, and no completion handler is established. This does not certify the exact beta dead end or normal gameplay reachability.
